rca of the issue: SHOP PDP add-to-cart was calling api.post('/shop/cart/items') directly. The POST succeeded (201) and the toast fired, but the local React CartContext state was never refreshed → nav badge stayed at 0 and /cart appeared empty until manual reload. Fix routes the call through useCart().addShopVariant which internally does `await load()` (Promise.all of /carts/me + /shop/cart/me) so the merged cart state repopulates before returning. Verified working: badge 0→1 immediately, /cart populated without refresh.
